about_the_game:
In a peaceful town, a group of werebears suddenly appeared, launching crazy attacks on humans and turning the whole area into a killing spree. Players will play as a brave hunter to track down and eliminate these fierce werebears, saving the town.

Gameplay:

  • In the game, players will embark on hunting missions in challenging environments, searching for werebears in scenes such as forests, abandoned buildings, etc., and eliminating them.

  • Players can use various weapons such as firearms, bows and arrows to fight against werebears, and also use traps, props, etc., to enhance the combat fun in the game.

  • During the game, players need to constantly improve their skills and equipment to better combat the increasingly powerful werebears.

Game Features:

  • Exquisite and realistic graphics and scene design, providing players with an immersive shooting experience.

  • Diverse weapon and prop choices, allowing players to make tactical combinations based on their preferences and game needs.

  • Thrilling and exciting game atmosphere, making players feel the tense and exhilarating shooting pleasure in the game.

Game Objectives:

  • Eliminate all werebears and save the town.

  • Improve your skills and equipment to become a top hunter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Quad Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 760 or Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Quad Core i7 3770K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 or Radeon R9 380X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Are you ready to hunt down the werebears and save the region from their reign of terror? Let's gear up and embark on this thrilling FPS adventure in “Werebear Hunt"!
